newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Asian Dev Bank raises lending rate on dlr loans.
newsitem.headline: Asian Dev Bank raises lending rate on dlr loans.

text.p: The Asian Development Bank said on Wednesday it raised its lending rate on dollar loans to 6.82 percent per annum effective on July 1 from 6.79 percent.
Its rate on multi-currency loans remain at six percent per annum.
Interest rates on the ADB's loans are adjusted on January 1 and July 1 each year.

The bank said its lending rate is determined by adding a spread to the preceding six months' average cost of its outstanding borrowings for each facility. The spread is currently at 0.4 percent per annum, it said.
